recognize_zh: 高倍下生發中心內混合大型中心母細胞（泡狀核、明顯核仁）與中等大小中心細胞，並可見有絲分裂；左側為深染小淋巴球構成的套區。細胞組成多樣而非單一，支持反應性生發中心。
features: Mixed population of large centroblasts with vesicular chromatin and one or more nucleoli
Intermediate-sized centrocytes with irregular, cleaved nuclei
Occasional mitotic figure within the germinal center
Pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and admixed histiocytes/dendritic cell nuclei
Sharp interface with a mantle of small round dark lymphocytes on the left
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a germinal center composed of a heterogeneous mixture of large centroblasts with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli, intermediate cleaved centrocytes, and admixed histiocytes, with an occasional mitotic figure. It is bordered by a mantle of small, round, darkly staining lymphocytes. The cellular heterogeneity and zonation support a reactive process. Findings are consistent with a reactive germinal center within the marrow; BCL2 and light chain studies can be used if lymphoma is a concern.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic follicles are monotonous, lack tingible-body macrophages and a polarized mantle, and are BCL2-positive with t(14;18).
DLBCL shows sheets of uniformly large atypical cells without an organized mantle or mixed centrocyte population.
Carcinoma forms cohesive nests of epithelial cells with keratin positivity, rather than a discohesive lymphoid population merging into a mantle zone.
